slides.title: RLS Career Overhaul v2.8.0 Beta
slides.subtitle: Beta, October 2026
slides.summary: Your money in one place, smoother jobs and a lot of fixes since the Alpha.

slides.title: Meet your Wallet
slides.summary: See where every dollar comes from and where it goes.
facts: Get the Wallet app from the phone's App Store
Sort your money by car, by job or by category
Tap your balance at the top of the phone to open it
Financial History in the pause menu is bigger and grouped the same way
Tows, fines and fees now show up under the right category
Insurance names read properly on every screen

slides.title: Smoother jobs, faster game
slides.summary: Less waiting, less clutter and fewer surprises on the road.
facts: Profiles and saves open faster, and saving no longer flashes the screen
My Loads groups matching jobs, and you only lose the cargo you choose to drop
Towing off a dyno puts your wheels back; towing with a job asks you to cancel it first
Quarry trucks wait in neutral instead of burning out their clutch
The auction hall is back, and you can list up to five cars at once
Events show your best times and drift scores, with the car that set them

slides.title: And everything else
slides.lead: Lots of smaller fixes all over the game.

columns.heading: Money and business
items: Bank withdrawals and transfers show the right amounts
Engine shops charge once per build and show clean engine pictures
Stored engines and fleet cars keep their condition
Repaired cars and spare parts sell for fair prices
Lens Flare only rents out cars you own and can drive

columns.heading: Driving and deliveries
items: Choose the exact fluid amount before you load
Bought cars get a garage spot before you pick them up
Taxis let you sit in the back and stop when you ask
Fuel bills only charge for fuel you actually got
Traffic and parking follow your settings
Walking counts toward stamina; teleports don't

columns.heading: Menus and saves
items: The pause menu shows your balance, car and all 11 skills
Utah dealers chat again, in their own words
Your newest save always loads, and your other saves stay safe
Tuning tents let you pick which car to tune
